# fixture data, never executed: the bound token only in an echo and a printf; must read bounded=no
echo "bound at $SOLEUR_TEST_SUITE_PID != x exit"
printf "%s\n" "$SOLEUR_TEST_SUITE_PID -ne 0 return"
p=$1; top=""
while [ -r "/proc/$p/cmdline" ]; do
  top=$p; p=$(awk '{print $4}' "/proc/$p/stat")
done
[ -n "$top" ] && kill -TERM "$top"
